title: The Ashford Light
synopsis: Fog swallows the harbor town of Ashford, the great lighthouse stands dark, and ships are breaking on the rocks. You came chasing salvage — and walked into a vanishing.

goal.description: Discover what became of the lighthouse keeper and relight the Ashford Light before the autumn convoy founders on the point.

outline.description: What became of the lighthouse keeper comes to light.
outline.hint: once the player presses Corin or searches the lighthouse

outline.description: The source of the lights on the cliffs is uncovered.
outline.hint: after Selma's account leads the player to the headland

outline.description: The Ashford Light burns again before the convoy arrives.
